headline: 58 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 832 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,854 acres and is 99% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **832 structures threatened**. 11 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 33 mph, sustained near 20) with humidity as low as 14%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (W, blowing toward the E) favors pushing the fire toward Hines city, 18 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over LA: Lafayette city, Lake Charles city, Alexandria city, DeRidder city, and Fort Polk South CDP and 15 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
